title: MED+250 privileged credential rotation deployment receipt
summary: Owner-ready redacted receipt for replacing and revoking previously exposed Supabase credentials. Rotation authority, private dependency inventory, replacement installation, old-credential failure proof and post-rotation verification remain pending.

checks.name: Private credential and dependency inventory
checks.detail: The security owner has not yet completed the controlled inventory of exposed credential classes, dependent applications, jobs, environments and accountable owners.

checks.name: Shared-project maintenance approval
checks.detail: Owners of every application using the shared Supabase project have not yet approved the rotation sequence, maintenance window, rollback contacts and interruption boundary.

checks.name: Replacement credentials installed
checks.detail: No redacted provider receipt yet proves replacement credentials were created and installed in every intended protected secret store without repository exposure.

checks.name: Dependent systems migrated
checks.detail: Protected CI, local operations, deployment, monitoring and scheduled-job dependencies have not yet been reconciled and positively verified one environment at a time.

checks.name: Old credentials revoked and rejected
checks.detail: The security owner has not yet retained redacted proof that every replaced credential was revoked and can no longer perform its former operation.

checks.name: Replacement least-privilege verification
checks.detail: The replacement credentials have not yet been shown to perform every required operation while failing operations outside their approved scope.

checks.name: Residual secret-material scan
checks.detail: Repository, build output, logs, shell history, temporary files and controlled evidence stores have not yet passed the approved residual-secret scan.

checks.name: Post-rotation backend and operations checks
checks.detail: The strict backend contract, aggregate operational health, security audit and launch-evidence verification must be rerun after the completed rotation.

completion_instructions: Complete the private credential and dependency inventory without copying any credential value into repository evidence.
Obtain shared-project owner approval for the rotation sequence and maintenance window.
Create replacements, update each dependent protected environment, revoke every old credential and prove each old credential fails.
Verify each replacement performs only its intended operation and complete the residual-secret scan.
Run the post-rotation backend, strict health, security and evidence commands in docs/launch/SECURITY_OWNER_REVIEW.md.
Confirm the review digest still matches, set every check to passed, add the deployment operator, role, timestamp, environment and redacted release identifier, and set status to complete.
Validate the completed receipt strictly and add it to the launch registry only with its exact SHA-256 digest.
